Artemis.wikitext:
{{Character |Portal ={{DeathwatchPortal}} |Name =Artemis |Image =ArtemisArt.jpg |Caption =Watch Captain Artemis{{Fn|6b}} |Title = |Homeworld =[[Talasa Prime]]{{Fn|6a}} |Birth = |Active Period =[[M41]] - Present |Death = |Cause of Death = |Species =[[Human]] |Type =[[Astartes]] |Gender =Male |Relatives =[[Roboute Guilliman]]
("father" via [[gene-seed]]) |Occupation ='' '' *[[Battle Brother]] of the [[Mortificators]]{{Fn|6a}} *[[Watch Captain]] of the [[Deathwatch]]{{Fn|6a}} |Preceded by = |Succeeded by = |Faction ='' '' *[[Imperium of Man]] **[[Mortificators]] **[[Deathwatch]] |Notes = }} '''Artemis''' is a [[Space Marine]] of the [[Mortifactors]] [[Chapter|Space Marine Chapter]], currently serving with the [[Deathwatch]] as a [[Watch Captain]] of [[Talasa Prime]].{{Fn|6a}} He developed uncanny skills for detecting the slightest hint of xenos taint and destroying any alien influence he may find.{{Fn|1}} ===Biography=== A veteran of a hundred campaigns, Artemis was recruited into the Mortifactors from barbaric nomadic tribes living on the [[Feral World]] of [[Posul]] a century before joining the Deathwatch. As a youth, Artemis was one of the greatest warriors of his tribe and paved the floor of his father's lodge with the skeletons of his slain enemies. Gaining many enemies due to his reputation, Artemis was ambushed by fifty warriors from an enemy tribe. Succeeding in killing them all, he nonetheless took heavy wounds and was only saved by the [[Chaplain]]s of the Mortifactors. Recognized for his strength, he was healed by the Chapter's [[Apothecary|Apothecaries]] and began the process of being transformed into a [[Space Marine]].{{Fn|1}} As a full battle-brother, Artemis quickly distinguished himself and showed great talent in the art of [[xenos]] slaying. Such were his skills that he became recognized by the [[Ordo Xenos]], which asked to recruit him into the Deathwatch. Artemis accepted the call and served first under [[Inquisitor]] [[Severnius]] against [[Genestealer]] cults on the [[Missionary World]] of [[St. Capilene]], helping save the planet from falling under [[Tyranid]] domination. Inquisitor Severnius praised Artemis, promoting him as second-in-command of his kill-team. For two decades he fought alongside Severnius, rooting out alien corruption wherever it may be found. On [[Varnix Prime]], he thwarted a [[Hrud]] attempt to capture an [[Adeptus Mechanicus]] base and while on the [[Agri-World]] of [[Tarrenhorst]] he and Severnius discovered an infestation of [[Warp]] entities that enslaved entire populations psychically.{{Fn|1}} It was Brother Artemis who, with his Kill-Team, answered the request from the [[Colonel]] of the [[Kaslon Regiment]] on [[Assumptus V]] of the [[Donorian Sector]]. The Deathwatch destroyed [[K'nib]] [[xenos]] on this planet and Artemis himself killed the [[Alcayde]] of this race, thus ending their incursions into Imperial space (though official records said that victory was obtained by the Kaslon regiment).{{Fn|3}} [[Image:ArtemisArt9th.jpg|thumb|right|330px|Artemis{{Fn|7}}]] It was against these new foes that Artemis and Severnius encountered one of their most daunting challenges. The creatures began attempting to psychically dominate the Kill-Team and bend them to their will. Though Severnius was able to physically shield most of the Kill-Team, three Space Marines fell under the aliens' control and turned their [[Bolter]]s on their brethren. A further two Space Marines were cut down by gunfire, but Artemis persevered and hacked down one of his erstwhile allies as the Kill-Team formed a defensive circle, assailed by hordes of alien-dominated victims. Artemis, Severnius, and the two remaining Space Marines fought viciously and were able to barricade themselves in a small temple dedicated to the [[Emperor]]. Severnius by this point was exhausted by having to maintain his psychic shield while the three Space Marines desperately held off enemy attacks. For six days this situation continued until the Kill-Team was able to finally contact [[Thunderhawk]] gunships and coordinate a rescue. But before the gunship could land, the weakened Servenius was killed by one of the enslaved Space Marines, and command of the Kill-Team now passed to Artemis. Once on their orbiting ship, Artemis declared [[Exterminatus]] and blasted the world with [[Cyclonic Torpedo]]es.{{Fn|1}} In the closing days of the 41st Millennium, Artemis foiled the ritual of [[Eldar]] [[Farseer]] [[Eldrad Ulthran]] in the [[Battle of Port Demesnus]]. During the battle, Artemis ignored the pleas of the Farseer to cooperate with him as he planned to destroy [[Slaanesh]], stating that he would rather see humanity fall to [[Chaos]] rather than trust the word of a [[xenos]]. The act inadvertently saved billions of [[Human]] lives.{{Fn|2}} Artemis continues to serve in the Deathwatch, destroying Xenos infestations wherever he may find them. He has gone on to become one of the most successful members of the Deathwatch, leading [[Watch Company Tertius (Talasa Prime)|Watch Company Tertius]] of [[Watch Fortress]] [[Talasa Prime]].{{Fn|1}}{{Fn|6b}} ===Wargear=== In battle, Artemis is armed with a special [[Combi-Flamer]]{{Fn|4}} named ''[[Hellfire Extremis]]'';{{Fn|6b}} its flamer component uses bio-alchemical toxic fire, the fuel of which stored in a compartment of his backpack. In close combat, he wields the relic [[power sword]] ''[[Exterminatus (Power Sword)|Exterminatus]]''.{{Fn|8}} Artemis lost his right hand in battle with Tyranids so it was replaced with a [[Imperial bionics|bionic]].{{Fn|4}} He also has a bionic eye with bio-detection capability.{{Fn|9}} ===Other minatures=== Artemis.jpg|[[Deathwatch]] [[Space Marine|Marine]] Artemis for [[Inquisitor (game)|Inquisitor]]{{Fn|5}} ArtemisDM.jpg|Artemis miniature ([[Warhammer 40,000 7th Edition Rulebook|7th Edition]]){{Fn|2}} ===Sources=== *{{Endn|1}}: [[White Dwarf 257 (UK)]], pgs. 94–95; [[White Dwarf 259]] — ''Defenders of the Imperium'', pgs. 42–43 *{{Endn|2}}: [https://www.games-workshop.com/en-US/Warhammer-40000-Death-Masque-ENG Warhammer 40,000: Death Masque] *{{Endn|3}}: [[White Dwarf 259 (UK)]], pg. 83 *{{Endn|4}}: [[White Dwarf September 2016]] - ''In Stores Now'' *{{Endn|5}}: Games Workshop Online Store: [[Inquisitor (game)|Inquisitor miniature range]] *6: [[Codex: Deathwatch (8th Edition)]]: **{{Endn|6a}}: pg. 15 **{{Endn|6b}}: pg. 35 *{{Endn|7}}: [https://www.warhammer-community.com/2020/11/04/the-art-of-your-new-codex-supplements/ Warhammer Community: The Art of Your New Codex Supplements (Posted 11/4/2020)] (last accessed 11/4/2020) *{{Endn|8}}: [[Deathwatch: Legends of the Dark Millennium (Novel)]], Chapter 8 *{{Endn|9}}: [[Inquisitor Rulebook]], pg. 103 — ''Deathwatch Battle Brother Artemis'' [[Category:Characters (Deathwatch)]] [[Category:Characters (Mortifactors)]] [[de:Artemis (Mortifactors)]] [[fr:Artemis (Watch Captain)]]

Artura Brenken.wikitext:
{{AstraMilitarumPortal}}
'''Artura Brenken''' was the [[Colonel]] of the [[252nd Armageddon Steel Legion]] [[Imperial Guard Regiment|Regiment]] and a close associate of [[Commissar]] [[Sebastian Yarrick]], working alongside him for more than seventy years.{{Fn|1a}} Her actions during the [[Second War for Armageddon]] would eventually lead her to become the ''de facto'' [[Imperial Guard Commander|Commander]] of all the native military forces of [[Armageddon]].{{Fn|1r}}


==Biography==
===Early Career===
At one point, Brenken was a [[Sergeant (Imperial Guard)|Sergeant]] serving in the 252nd Regiment's Sixth Company. She received an unexpected field promotion to [[Captain (Imperial Guard)|Captain]] following the action to capture the [[frigate]] ''[[Castellan Belasco]]''; she and her forces successfully completed their mission, whereas her commanding officer, the previous Captain of Sixth Company, was found wanting and executed by [[Commissar]] [[Sebastian Yarrick|Yarrick]].{{Fn|2}}

In her first action as Captain, Brenken led the Sixth Company when they responded to a distress call sent from the [[Imperial]] world of [[Molossus]]. The world's main settlement, [[Hive Pyrrhus]], was suffering from a mass revolt. The company descended into the [[underhive]] intent on crushing the uprising, only to find that the violent mobs they faced were not, in fact, a mass rebellion, but a terrified response to the true threat on the world - an outbreak of [[Plague Zombies]]. Brenken and the 252nd successfully held the line while Commissar Yarrick set off a [[melta bomb]] within Pyrrhus' gigantic [[promethium]] refinery, purging the underhive with flame and eliminating the taint.{{Fn|2}}

===Prelude to Armageddon===
Years later, Brenken was eventually promoted to Colonel and given command of the 252nd Steel Legion. She commanded the regiment in the defence of the [[Agri World]] of [[Basquit]] from an [[Ork]] horde. Although she regarded the Imperial victory on Basquit as satisfactory, Commissar Yarrick believed the presence of the Orks, far away from any known [[Ork World]] and close to the strategically crucial world of [[Armageddon]], was an ill omen. This was compounded by the emergence of a severe [[Warp Storm]] that threatened to isolate the [[Armageddon System]] from the rest of the Imperium.{{Fn|1a}}

===[[Second War for Armageddon]]===
On returning to Armageddon, Yarrick shared his concerns with [[Planetary Governor|Overlord]] [[Herman von Strab]]. Von Strab, however, dismissed the threat and told Yarrick not to take action.{{Fn|1a}} When Yarrick's worst fears were confirmed and Armageddon was invaded by an army of Orks led by the [[Ork Warlord|Warlord]] [[Ghazghkull Thraka]], Brenken proved to be one of Yarrick's main allies in the conflict, alongside [[Princeps]] [[Kurtiz Mannheim]] of the [[Legio Metalica]] and [[Setheno]] the [[Canoness|Canoness-Errant]]{{Fn|1b}}; the Imperial forces on Armageddon had to struggle against not only the invading [[xenos]], but the incompetence, insanity and paranoia of von Strab.{{Fn|1a}}{{Fn|1b}}{{Fn|1c}}

When the Orks reached Armageddon, they made planetfall via a massive [[Space Hulk]] codified as the ''[[Claw of Desolation]]'', landing in [[Armageddon Prime]] near [[Hive Tempestora]] and [[Hive Volcanus]].{{Fn|1d}} Von Strab deployed the 252nd Regiment to Armageddon Prime to investigate while the majority of Armageddon's armed forces were held in reserve in [[Armageddon Secundus]], east of the [[Equatorial Jungle]] that separated the two continents.{{Fn|1c}}{{Fn|1d}} As there were two major hives close to the Orks' landing site, Brenken chose to divide the 252nd Regiment's forces into two; she took half of the 252nd to reinforce Volcanus while the remainder, led by Captain [[Stahl (Armageddon)|Stahl]] and including Commissar Yarrick, reconnoitred Tempestora.{{Fn|1d}}

Stahl's half of the regiment immediately ran into stiff resistance, with the bulk of the regiment's transports being shot down by Ork artillery.{{Fn|1d}} Yarrick, however, convinced Stahl to press on to Tempestora and take the fight to the Orks, hoping to distract the xenos so that Brenken would have more time to prepare Volcanus.{{Fn|1d}}{{Fn|1e}} However, despite the extensive defences of Volcanus{{Fn|1e}}{{Fn|1f}}, Ghazghkull was able to outmanoeuvre the Imperial defenders and overwhelm the hive.{{Fn|1g}}{{Fn|1h}}{{Fn|1i}}{{Fn|1j}} Yarrick and Brenken were forced to flee Volcanus, travelling by [[Chimera]] to the abandoned settlement of [[Irkalla]]{{Fn|1j}}{{Fn|1k}} and extracting by [[Valkyrie]] to [[Hive Infernus]].{{Fn|1l}}

On returning to Infernus, Brenken and Mannheim agreed to distract Overlord von Strab while Yarrick went to Armageddon's main [[Astropath]] choir to send a call for help from the [[Adeptus Astartes]].{{Fn|1m}}{{Fn|1n}}{{Fn|1o}}{{Fn|1p}}

Von Strab, furious at Yarrick for broadcasting a distress call without his authorisation, reassigned him to [[Hades Hive]].{{Fn|1p}}{{Fn|1q}} Brenken remained in Hive Infernus. Although she was no longer working directly with Yarrick, she continued working against von Strab. Not long afterwards, she, Setheno, and a number of other Armageddon officers confronted [[General]] [[Andechs]], commander of the Steel Legion forces on Armageddon.{{Fn|1r}} Andechs, although a seasoned commander, was beholden to Overlord von Strab and was therefore unwilling to countermand him despite the Overlord's lack of military sense.{{Fn|1c}}{{Fn|1r}} Brenken urged him to allow the Steel Legion to support the deployment of the Legio Metalica, which had been ordered to engage the Ork advance alone. Andechs refused and so Brenken, acting with Yarrick's authority, executed Andechs and assumed command of the Steel Legions.{{Fn|1r}}

("father" via [[gene-seed]]) |Occupation ='' '' *[[Grey Knights Brother-Captain|Brother-Captain]] of the [[3rd Brotherhood (Grey Knights)|Grey Knights 3rd Brotherhood]]{{Fn|2a}} |Preceded by = |Succeeded by = |Faction ='' '' *[[Imperium of Man]] **[[Grey Knights]] |Notes = }} '''[[Brother-Captain]] Arvann Stern''' has served the [[Grey Knights]] for many long years and is a prominent [[Daemonhunter]]. Stern is nearing his fourth century in the Emperor's service, but he continues to serve within the [[3rd Brotherhood (Grey Knights)|3rd Brotherhood]].{{Fn|2a}} === History === Stern's fate is inextricably linked with that of the [[Lord of Change]] named [[M'Kachen]], the instigator of the [[Cult of the Red Talon]]. During the [[Ordo Malleus]]'s destruction of the cult, Stern faced and banished the daemon back into the warp for one hundred years and a day. When the daemon was able to return to the mortal realm he was determined to find Stern and devour his soul. The two have faced each other in battle several times. If unable to personally face Stern, M'kachen sends one of his most powerful servants to attempt the deed for him. Stern has battled M'kachen three times so far. Each time, the Brother-Captain has proven his ability to withstand the power of the daemon and defeat the creature.{{Fn|2b}} Stern also took part in the final stages of the [[Siege of Vraks]] in late [[M41]], helping to defeat the [[Daemon Prince]] [[Uraka Az'baramael]].{{Fn|1}} He later worked closely with the [[Space Wolves]] during the [[Siege of the Fenris System]] after discovering that the [[Wulfen]] were not a [[Chaos]]-corrupted threat.{{Fn|4}} During the [[Age of the Dark Imperium]] Arvann Stern resurfaced, leading the 3rd Brotherhood in the [[Assault on Sortiarius]] alongside the [[Dark Angels]] 5th Company.{{Fn|5}} During the [[Season of Blood]] he served under Grand Master [[Aldrik Voldus]] in leading the 3rd Brotherhood to [[Armageddon]], intending to reinforce the 5th Brotherhood under [[Rothwyr Morvans]] but only arriving in the later stages of the battle. Nonetheless, Voldus and Stern were able to drive off the [[Chaos]] fleet over Armageddon.{{Fn|6}} ===Wargear=== Stern is armed with a [[Nemesis Force Weapon]] and has a [[Storm Bolter]] integrated into his [[Terminator armour]]. He is also a trained [[psyker]] and has a plethora of [[Imperial Psychic Powers|Psychic powers]] at his command.{{Fn|2c}} ===[[Quotes Space Marines#S|Quotes]]=== *''"There is nothing in the arcane and blasphemous arsenal of the forces of [[Chaos]] that can compare to faith. With the power of faith, our weapons become shining instruments of deliverance that can cleave the mightiest daemon in twain. With the power of faith, our minds appear as slivers of pure agony to the daemon, driving into the wretched forms of those who would dare stand before us. With the power of faith, our words become commands that cause the daemon to cower and cringe in terror. I could meet my enemies unarmed without a shred of fear in my chest, for I know that the Emperor watches over me and guides my hand. So let them come. We shall show them what the power of faith can do."''{{Cite This}} ===Images=== [[Image:Grey Knight Captain Stern.JPG|thumb|center|Stern's Miniature{{Fn|3}}]] ===Sources=== *{{Endn|1}}: [[Imperial Armour Volume Seven - The Siege of Vraks - Part Three]], pgs. 76–86 *{{Endn|2}}: [[Codex: Grey Knights (7th Edition)]] **{{Endn|2a}}: ''Chapter Organisation'' **{{Endn|2b}}: ''Arvann Stern'' **{{Endn|2c}}: ''Forces of the Grey Knights, Brother-Captain Stern'' *{{Endn|3}}: [http://www.games-workshop.com/en-US/Grey-Knights-Brother-Captain-Stern Games Workshop Webstore] ''(last accessed 24 June 2015)'' *{{Endn|4}}: [[War Zone Fenris: Curse of the Wulfen]] Chapter 2 *{{Endn|5}}: [[Psychic Awakening: Ritual of the Damned]] pg.10-11 *{{Endn|6}}: [[Crusade: Armageddon]], pg. 40 ====Uncited==== {{Uncited}} *[[Codex: Grey Knights (5th Edition)]], pg. 14 *[[Codex: Daemonhunters]] {{GKUnits}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Stern, Arvann}} [[Category:Characters (Grey Knights)]] [[de:Stern (Grey Knights)]] [[fr:Stern (Chevalier Gris)]]
